Package org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.impl.scanner

Class LifeCyclePolicyScanner

java.lang.Object
org.opencastproject.lifecyclemanagement.impl.scanner.LifeCyclePolicyScanner
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.felix.fileinstall.ArtifactInstaller, org.apache.felix.fileinstall.ArtifactListener
public class LifeCyclePolicyScanner extends Object implements org.apache.felix.fileinstall.ArtifactInstaller
Loads, unloads, and reloads LifeCyclePolicys from "*policy.yml" files in any of fileinstall's watch directories.
